units.known_address_notes: Dedaub Jul-2021 audit of Immunefi BugReportNotary/Escrow + lib/math/utils + token/distributor/vesting modules at commit a6095b96. PDF extracted (24.9KB text): no address, no explorer link, no repo URL beyond the commit hash. Immunefi org repos are docs/PoC only (Web3-Security-Library, forge-poc-templates); no public contract repo, no published vesting/distributor address found -> instance unpublished.

units.titles: Cloning a `subGauge` can result in an uninitialized proxy | Codebase is using a vulnerable Vyper compiler version
units.known_address_notes: Report: veTenet (Curve-style vote-escrow gauge system: AddressRegistry, GaugeProxy, RewardVault, TLSD Factory, subGauges) deployed on Tenet; repo tenet-org/veTenet-contracts @434bcc0a. GitHub API: tenet-org/veTenet-contracts = 404 (deleted) and the veTenet repo is not among the 34 remaining tenet-org repos, so no deployments/ or broadcast/ artifacts. Chain itself could not be queried: rpc.tenet.org returns an empty body for eth_chainId and eth_blockNumber, explorer.tenet.org returns empty for ap

units.titles: Malicious user can steal NFTs from anybody | Merkle proof can be used numerous times | Merkle proof verification can be bypassed | Malicious users can frontrun non malicious buyers, and make them overpay | Trade deal participants can steal the APR from other participants
units.known_address_notes: Halborn audit (2025) of Nomyx Gemforce: EIP-2535 diamond (DiamondFactory, ERC721A/Marketplace/MultiSale/Identity facets). Contracts are diamond-deployed per customer, and neither the report nor the Gemforce docs publish a diamond or factory address (the 0x... addresses printed in the report body are forge test-log EOAs, e.g. 0x328809Bc... appearing as 'owner of the NFT' in a local test). Chain not stated; docs describe multi-network deployment. No deployable address found.
